headline: Knee-to-thigh short-period S — sneak a morning log before the onshore.
today: Good-angle S swell but only 3-4.5s and under 2ft, so it's small and mushy. Light N to SE wind at dawn and morning is your clean window; afternoon S goes onshore and kills it. Grab the log early and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Tiny at 1.3ft but N offshore in the morning cleans it up. Marginal size, decent conditions — dawn patrol only if you're desperate.
Size jumps toward 3ft but SSW wind ramps to 19mph onshore by afternoon. Blown out — not worth the trip.
